notes.title: Developer Live Stream
notes.content:
Come hang out and watch the developer play Vault: Tomb of the King for the Steam Games Festival!

Steam stream starts on Saturday June 20 at 8:30PM EST.

- Get a glimpse of some un-seen content and learn more about the game.

- Ask questions, suggest ideas and get behind the scenes information.

- Give him a hard time as he dies over and over.

Hope to see you there!

[previewyoutube=Gud_-HCsWbY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Vault Discord AMA
notes.content:
As part of the Steam Games Festival, the developer will be available on Discord to answer any and all questions you have!

Join us on Discord([url=https://discord.gg/qK68vBq]https://discord.gg/qK68vBq[/url]) - June 16 at 8:30PM EST. 

- Come discuss the free demo, the full game and future plans.

- Suggest your ideas and be a part of the development process.

- Get to know an indie developer and make some new friends.
